anchors.0: Lowest query priority, not a feasibility rejection
anchors.1: Highest query priority, not a safety guarantee

constraints: Python computes all class-1 features and memberships; LLM cannot relabel
Inactive memberships are not missing; missing memberships are excluded, not replaced with zero
portal_1d is a type, not evidence of narrowness or low priority
Top-k frequency is not all-path necessity
Never remove retained regions or connections because of a low score
status: Experimental scoring policy; not calibrated or validated by planner outcomes
pending_agreement: Supervisor review of score anchors and calibration examples
Stability and factual accuracy of LLM scores across repeated runs
scoring_policy: LLM directly assigns each region/connection one priority score in [0,1] and a short reason from graph topology, start/goal, sequences, available features and Python-computed class-1 labels. No separate per-label weights or arithmetic score aggregation.
